article.scientific_question: Construct an absolute and high-precision relative catalog to characterize the Maple Creek sequence and its spatial/temporal structure.

construction_workflow.summary: UUSS routine detections and phase picks are absolutely located with HYPOINVERSE, waveform differential times are measured with BCSEIS, and GrowClust provides hierarchical relative relocations with bootstrap uncertainty.

input_data.name: UUSS routine detections and phase picks

evidence.locator: Observation and network conditions; Catalog-construction workflow

input_data.name: waveforms for differential times
input_data.channels_sampling: P/S waveform windows; exact sample metadata not extracted
input_data.availability_conditions: 22 local + 2 regional stations selected for quality/azimuth; no station-day table.

stages.name: absolute routine location
stages.purpose: Provide initial event origins and coda magnitudes.

stages.name: waveform differential-time measurement
stages.purpose: Measure precise P/S pair delays for relative relocation.
stages.method: BCSEIS cross-correlation on P and S windows; article reports 73% P and 27% S.

stages.name: GrowClust relative relocation
stages.purpose: Refine relative event geometry and quantify uncertainty.
stages.method: Hierarchical sequential grid-search relocation with 100 bootstrap runs.
stages.dependencies: Absolute starting catalog and waveform pairs.

construction_workflow.final_output: Article reports 3,345 absolute and 3,257 relocated events; no local event-table output is available.
